status: Design only; do not start production changes until glacial native/performance gates are complete.
problem: Existing wooded-swamp captures read mostly as dry forest with isolated small oval pools. Marsh and swamp need coherent wet ground/open water, emergent plants and dry hummocks rather than a generic lawn.

research.application: Separate groundwater/depression wetlands from river floodplain/backwater wetlands; standing pools need physically contained datums.
Oxbows are abandoned meanders, not arbitrary crescents anywhere in a wet biome.
A future fjord must be an ocean-connected flooded glacial trough, not a detached sea-level water sheet.

leading_candidate: Extend the surveyed SmallWaterBodies wetland path into larger irregular shallow complexes with dry hummocks and connected lobes/channels. Preserve ordinary ponds separately. Choose dimensions/admission after surveying actual marsh sites, not by blindly increasing every radius.
requirements: One constant surveyed head per finite complex; actual shared bed, shoreline mask, swimming/drinking classification and rooted vegetation.
Contained dry outer collar; do not excavate giant steep-sided bowls on sloping forest ground or float a water plane across it.
Dry hummocks use inherited soil or physically bounded peat deposition, allowing trees on emergent patches; shallow water admits reeds/rushes and removes upland lawn.
Coherent wetland intensity/style provinces; peatland, open marsh, wooded swamp and ordinary upland forest should remain distinct.
Grid/support/thinning math must guarantee complete candidate discovery at grid and sphere-face boundaries. Existing3D shell stencil is27cells; budget any increase explicitly.
Existing terrain/water meshes and materials, no extra scenery draw objects or global wetland simulation. Keep caching bounded.
Numerical containment, exact shared edges, candidate-order/cache-eviction stability; actual native water/vegetation captures and moving-frame/loading evidence.
other_followups: ExposedRock currently removes organic matter before the wet/peat floor is re-added. Consider moving that suppression after wet/peat application, with a focused wet bare-wall test; do not mix into the current exact-output performance proof.
Fjords/cirques/oxbows remain future candidates; pick the most visible missing geography after the next accepted feature rather than treating this list as mandatory.
reports: One PDF at end only. Retain failures and actual acceptance limits. All own Unity/player windows rightmost.
